title: MYR Group Inc. Announces First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call Schedule
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about MYR Group Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://investor.myrgroup.com/node/16191/pdf)


THORNTON, Colo., April 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **MYR Group Inc. (“MYR Group”) (NASDAQ: MYRG)** , a holding company of leading specialty contractors serving the electric utility infrastructure, commercial and industrial construction markets in the United States and Canada, announced it will release its first quarter 2026 results on Wednesday, Apr. 29, 2026, after the market closes. In conjunction with the release, MYR Group has scheduled a conference call and simultaneous webcast to discuss results on Thursday, Apr. 30, 2026, at 8 a.m. Mountain Time.


To participate via telephone and join the call live, please register in advance here:[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIb2b0665d809c4dcb972f1f82519c1892](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tLRel9YpwVZBZPZBu_OB063KyQ1wNfztOCaGfE6IJXKToIPa4gBwA3CzRTQQEmmK8kKVYzUHyZ_X2r2fGQBkccN9tV0BL5fFwRR6WXkdGiBCmbGMa_xIr7g5vutAozbP0AtjuKccXxOl2r3oP4yxDQHYhOuIOWZieAgfYbOe_fJiEEaSocGDhOpOsSrMEpoOkr7eny6SmWu1KxQ815E8jd_Od0aEMV18lQi6fUAFGHTfoHWt6lmJLfA6Tp9FTq69l28dt7_PFyrMNTJS0RAjU-d_D3qIqeEsSF0FTG19Ur149T6GgVs6k4qlfUoWJV1hvhGAaA-2q94KmdvGYYF0UaVQo4BNj__bZ09lZhJTkxx1az1oVeyoI4hj7ShpXdv2AgkTmz6Lg4jPnupmCbtpZTAxj5dBYWHAScp5Tjkc1toyA4_w5JzoImnIgxapmxxy) . Upon registration, telephone participants will receive a confirmation email detailing how to join the conference call, including the dial-in number and a unique passcode.


Participants may access the audio-only webcast of the conference call from the[Investors page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Q2GcrvOjC80vUcFv5tmXSvf3NlKQuS3OM6-wVfhbgHka2TEDaam580-siTLI5cIfRdy95aZ5wRJC3GGlQdd2N1es2DrtIyMLMmaJ-QOa2hc=) of MYR Group’s website at[myrgroup.com](http://myrgroup.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available for seven days.


**About MYR Group Inc.**
MYR Group is a holding company of leading, specialty electrical contractors providing services throughout the United States and Canada through two business segments: Transmission & Distribution (T&D) and Commercial & Industrial (C&I). MYR Group subsidiaries have the experience and expertise to complete electrical installations of any type and size. Through their T&D segment they provide services on electric transmission, distribution networks, substation facilities, clean energy projects, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. Their comprehensive T&D services include design, engineering, procurement, construction, upgrade, maintenance, and repair services. T&D customers include investor-owned utilities, cooperatives, private developers, government-funded utilities, independent power producers, independent transmission companies, industrial facility owners, and other contractors. Through their C&I segment, they provide a broad range of services which include the design, installation, maintenance, and repair of commercial and industrial wiring generally for data centers, airports, hospitals, hotels, stadiums, commercial and industrial facilities, clean energy projects, manufacturing plants, processing facilities, water/waste-water treatment facilities, mining facilities, intelligent transportation systems, roadway lighting, signalization, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. C&I customers include general contractors, commercial and industrial facility owners, government agencies, and developers. For more information, visit[myrgroup.com](http://myrgroup.com/) .
